title: Test Runs UI is slow: every test-run list request and every state snapshot projects all 8,186 retained runs under the global state lock
outcome: Opening and refreshing the Test Runs view stays responsive as retained runs grow: a test-run list page costs work proportional to the page, not to every retained run; the list is not projected twice per request; the global state lock is not held for the projection on the async executor; and the full state snapshot no longer carries every retained run summary. Before/after measurements on the same host are recorded.
acceptance: Test Runs UI is slow: every test-run list request and every state snapshot projects all 8,186 retained runs under the global state lock is done
